paras: Soudthichak's bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus soudthichaki) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Laos.
The specific name, soudthichaki, is in honor of Laotian conservationist Sisomphone Soudthichak.
C. soudthichaki is found in central Laos, in Khammouane Province.
The preferred natural habitat of C. soudthichaki is forest, at altitudes of 150–170 m (490–560 ft).
Relatively small for its genus, C. soudthichaki may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 7 cm (2.8 in).
The mode of reproduction of C. soudthichaki is unknown.
